01 — Why we make

We make fewer things, more carefully — objects that survive a decade of breakfasts.

Every piece is thrown, fired and sorted by hand in workshops we visit ourselves. If a batch doesn't meet the standard it doesn't leave the studio, and the note we ship with it says why.

The range stays at twenty-four objects. A new piece arrives only when an old one is retired — a slower way to run a shop, and the only one we know how to do properly.

03 — Studio

Twelve workshops,
one standard.

We started in 2019 with one wheel, two shelves and a landlord who let us fire in the back yard. Today we work with twelve family workshops, most within a day's drive of Bangkok. We know every potter by name and buy in person, never from a catalogue.

It means we can't scale quickly, and we've made peace with it. It also means that when a firing goes wrong, we hear about it the same week — from the person who was standing at the kiln.

01 — Selected

We buy the batch, or we don't.

Pieces are chosen on the table, not from a sample sheet. Anything that wobbles or sits badly in the hand stays behind.

02 — Fired

Fourteen hours at 1,280 °C.

A slow reduction firing gives the glaze its depth. We lose roughly one piece in nine to the kiln.

03 — Sorted

Every piece is checked twice.

Once at the workshop, once in our studio. Seconds are priced down and labelled with the actual flaw.

The dip in this rim is where the potter's thumb slipped. We kept it.

Notes on imperfection — shipped with batch 07

06 — Questions

The things people
ask before ordering.

Anything else, write to us. One of us answers, usually within a few hours.

studio@bunnyshop.co

Bangkok and surrounding provinces arrive in 1–2 working days, the rest of Thailand in 2–4. International orders ship with DHL and take 4–8 working days. Everything leaves the studio within 48 hours, Monday to Saturday.

Yes. Use it, wash it, and if it doesn't settle into your kitchen within fourteen days, send it back. We cover return postage on anything that arrives damaged or different from what you ordered, and refund in full within three working days.

Yes — unbleached board, paper tape, moulded pulp corners and a linen ribbon we ask you to reuse. No bubble wrap, no foam, no plastic sleeve. We tested forty-two combinations before settling on this one; nothing has broken in transit since 2022.

Hand-wash with a soft sponge and let it air dry upside down. The glaze is food-safe and stable, but it doesn't like thermal shock — let the piece come to room temperature before hot water, and skip the microwave. Linen washes at 30 °C on a gentle cycle.

From twenty pieces upward, with custom glazes above two hundred. Restaurants tend to reorder the Daily Bowl twice a year. Write to studio@bunnyshop.co with quantities and we'll send a costed sheet within a day.

A membership for people who buy more than once a year: 15% off everything, first access to each batch, and a repair service for anything that chips. It costs $24 a year, and you can leave whenever you like.
